purpose: Deployment-wide TimescaleDB hypertable storage composition, growth and backend-owned quota severity.
primaryGoal: Identify the largest and fastest-growing hypertables and imminent quota pressure without changing measurements, retention settings or backend thresholds.

dataSources.response: Handler returns an httputil data envelope containing hypertables; fetchEnvelope unwraps locally. HypertableSize JSON tags match frontend snake_case fields. Null/absent est_days_to_quota is supported; other numeric fields are nonnullable in the inspected Go/TS contract.
dataSources.behavior: Query key ['admin','observability','disk-forecast']; staleTime STANDARD 60000 ms; polling SLOW 60000 ms; refetchIntervalInBackground false; retry 1; AbortSignal forwarded. No parameters or mutation hooks.
dataSources.units: Bytes, counts, bytes/day, estimated days and severity. Summary adapts bytes/day to bytes/second and days to seconds only in its presentation metric input, then displays day units. Wire/cache fields remain unchanged.
dataSources.forecastSemantics: Repository computes max(total_bytes minus 30-day historical bytes, 0)/30. Missing historical map entry is read as zero by current source. Days are rounded only with configured positive quota and positive growth below quota; quota reached/exceeded yields zero days and critical. No client-side threshold inference.
dataSources.unsupported: Service maps missing repository or Timescale-unavailable error to ErrNotConfigured. Page interprets fatal HTTP 503 as unsupported; actual deployed endpoint/auth/envelope behavior not exercised.
dataSources.workspace: Deployment snapshot, no vehicle/date arguments. /admin/disk-forecast is not RANGE_ENABLED_PATHS; /admin disables workspace vehicle selection at workspaceScope.ts:94. Preserve this scope rather than adding duplicate or nonfunctional selectors.

duplicatedPatterns.detail: Growth, quota and table repeat loading/fatal-error/empty/content branches around existing LayoutCard/feedback primitives (also lines 450 and 488). Chart branches already belong to EmbeddedChart. This is local repetition, not evidence for a new global component.
duplicatedPatterns.fix: Reuse current source-state contracts and preserve section-specific explanations; consider a local typed extraction only if it materially improves orchestration. Do not introduce another state or card library.

responsive.status: Source inspected; every viewport remains unverified.
strengths: Composition stacks until xl with min-w-0; outlook stacks until 2xl.
Quota rows wrap and names use break-words.
Shared layout maintains allocated full width.

issues.rule: MDC-023 / MDC-043 / no mobile information loss
issues.detail: mobileColumns exposes hypertable/severity/days only. Total, compressed/uncompressed split and daily growth are hidden below md by DataTable.tsx:724-725. Caller provides neither expandable/renderExpanded nor mobilePresentation. Top-ten composition and top-eight growth do not expose every table's omitted measurements.
issues.fix: Use existing table expansion/mobile detail contract or preserve all columns in a bounded scrollable table. Keep all six columns, chunk counts, filters, source order, pagination and tableId.

issues.detail: Composition dedicates 132px to the Y axis plus margins and truncates names at 18 characters. At narrow allocated widths this may leave little plot space; no viewport was exercised, so clipping or unusability is not established.
issues.fix: Validate narrow-container plot and accessible full-name data alternative first; adapt existing axis/size props if needed without deleting series or hypertable identities.

accessibility.status: Keyboard, focus, screen reader, target sizes, effective contrast, forced colors and reduced motion not exercised.
strengths: Named sections and localized chart ariaLabel values.
Both charts provide dataColumns; ChartContainer.tsx:680-686 explicitly retains a forced-colors table alternative.
Critical alert and severity badges use text, not color alone.
LayoutCard names its own card using the title ID.

issues.detail: DataTable caller supplies no caption. DataTable.tsx:293 supports one; LayoutCard's aria-labelledby names the containing card, not automatically the nested table.
issues.fix: Pass the localized Hypertables caption through the existing API; verify actual table naming and keyboard filter/pagination behavior.

issues.detail: The unknown severity tier is named only '—' in the donut, legend and detail badge, unlike textual OK/Warn/Critical tiers. A neutral dash does not explain that classification is unknown.
issues.fix: Use a localized Unknown label for this tier without reclassifying it as OK/offline/error or changing server severity.

states.initialLoading: Four content groups stay mounted. Summary uses source.status initial; charts use query.isLoading; growth/quota/table render contextual 200/280px skeletons.
states.empty: Composition, severity, growth and table have localized distinct explanations. Summary knows whether a payload exists and uses measured zero aggregates for an explicitly empty inventory, rather than claiming zero before a response.
states.unsupported: Fatal 503 yields DataStateNotice unsupported at page:264 and suppresses generic errors. Charts/outlook still show their empty messages; table mounts empty DataTable when subsystemMissing, while the explicit unsupported notice remains.
states.fatalFailure: Other fatal errors reach summary QueryError and all section error branches; retry refetches the existing query.
states.refreshFailure: Only fatalError drives showError, so retained rows/charts survive failed refresh. Summary receives retained=true when stale or refreshing; PageContainer receives query/dataSources for shared freshness notices.
states.offline: deriveDataState distinguishes paused refresh; page retains available payload. Actual offline notice, retry recovery and cold offline loading behavior unverified.
states.unknown: Optional days use dash and filter exclusions. Other numeric fields are nonnullable in inspected backend contract, but nullish fallbacks would render zero for malformed/mismatched payloads; partial transport resilience is not proven.

issues.detail: No estimated rows always yields 'No quota configured', echoed by summary:53. Repository:133-150 also omits estimates when quota IS configured but growth is zero below quota; empty inventory and unsupported source can produce the same client condition. Absence of an estimate is not proof of missing configuration.
issues.fix: Use a truthful no-estimate explanation identifying possible causes, or consume authoritative quota metadata only if an integration owner explicitly adds it. Preserve configured zero-days critical cases; do not guess configuration.

visualIssues.rule: MDC-010 / MDC-011 / MDC-034 / restrained semantic palette
visualIssues.detail: Local hex palette drives donut, stacked bars, severity dots and MetricBar. Amber/green composition colors duplicate warning/success meanings even though compression status is not quota severity. This bypasses canonical chart/theme choices; saturation and contrast were not measured. No neon/glow source pattern was found.
visualIssues.fix: Reuse the existing restrained chart palette for storage composition and canonical severity colors for quota status. Retain all categories, user chart preferences and textual labels; no new palette registry.

visualIssues.detail: Critical days force text-rose-300 instead of canonical semantic text treatment. This is less intense than neon but not proof of contrast on light or customized backgrounds.
visualIssues.fix: Use existing semantic danger text tokens while retaining the critical badge and numeric days; measure composed contrast.

visualIssues.detail: Both axes force fontSize 10 (also line 328), bypassing shared typography sizing/preferences.
visualIssues.fix: Use current chart typography tokens/preferences and verify long names and 200% text; preserve tick formatting and plotted series.

architectureIssues.detail: DataTable is nested in LayoutCard but omits variant='embedded'. Shared DataTable defaults to standalone at line 452 and applies its own frame at line 1339.
architectureIssues.fix: Adopt existing embedded variant after validating toolbar, filtering, pagination and scroll preservation; no new wrapper.

order: Restore full per-row mobile measurement access
priority.reason: Mobile measurement reachability and misleading quota interpretation outweigh cosmetic refinements.

requiredSharedChanges.propsVariantsStates: Reuse expandable/renderExpanded or verified mobilePresentation, caption and variant='embedded'. Chart frames, trust notices and OperationalBrief already exist.
requiredSharedChanges.note: If explicit quota-configured metadata is desired, backend/type integration needs separate ownership. Current contract does not expose it, and truthful page copy can avoid that change.

competingImplementations.detail: Local severity hex mapping competes with canonical semantic/chart color ownership; reuse rather than add another registry.
competingImplementations.scopeLimit: No other pages or alternate disk-forecast components were inventoried.

Preserve server severity, critical alert count, totals, compression shares, largest and soonest selection.
Keep all rows in the detail table and raw payload/cache values unchanged.
Preserve signed/zero/missing semantics according to actual source contract; do not change forecast calculations during visual work.
Keep deployment scope, query key, cancellation, polling, retry, retained data, translations and number preferences.
Keep unsupported/fatal/empty explanations and every section reachable; source inspection is not proof of runtime preservation.
